verdict.rationale: Box's own developer portal names a first-party 'Box CLI' as a way for AI agents to reach Box content, so an official CLI exists. The evidence is a single one-line mention with no detail on commands, installation, auth, or agent-oriented output. missing for 10: CLI documentation (install, commands, auth flow), evidence of AI-native features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive use, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Give AI agents access to Box content through the Box CLI or the Box MCP server.
